stance_rationale: The draft cannot be accepted as an alpha package: mandatory alpha_scores.parquet, WT-local weights.csv, covariance.parquet, challenge_note, and artifact lineage are absent at the requested paths. The reported overlay evidence also fails the enhancement thesis: all overlay specs reduce SR versus C0, with only marginal MDD/Calmar relief and very high correlation to baseline.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores.parquet is missing at qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260512_001. Only alpha_overlay_returns.csv exists, and it is portfolio-return level, not Date x Ticker x score; it has 261 monthly rows but 2 final rows with missing C0/C1/C2/C3 returns.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: No current WT Date x Ticker x Z_Score_Aligned artifact; package cites inherited scale() per sig_date rather than auditable Z_Score_Aligned output.
No alpha_scores.parquet and no Usable_Date <= sig_date proof in current WT artifacts.
Current script reads CSV/parquet artifacts directly and does not show load_month_factors() for inherited factor score audit.
AR beta and M4 weights are shifted by 1 month before merge via shift(..., 1).
Fundamental lag is only inherited from prior PD30 claims; no current annual-May or quarterly-45d lag audit artifact is present.

critical_concerns.description: Mandatory artifacts named by the review request are absent: qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260512_001 does not exist, alpha_scores.parquet is missing, covariance.parquet is missing, WT-local weights.csv is missing, and no alpha_package/risk_package/optimization_package/challenge_note files exist for this WT. This blocks independent verification rather than merely weakening confidence.

The submitted alpha evidence is portfolio-return level, not the required Date x Ticker x score time-series alpha. alpha_overlay_returns.csv cannot verify ticker-level PIT, liquidity, sector-neutral behavior, monotonicity, or time-varying universe membership; final rows dated 2026-04-01 and 2026-05-01 also have missing C0/C1/C2/C3 returns despite the package reporting the range through 2026-05-01.

Harvey and IC diagnostics are incomplete: only CAPM is run, full CAPM/Carhart/FF5/FF6 reporting is deferred, ICIR is not numerically reported, sub_stability is absent, sector-neutral ICIR drop is absent, and monotonicity is absent. The inherited rank_IC=0.0489 is not enough to validate this WT's overlay claim.

The enhancement thesis fails on its own reported metrics: C1/C2/C3 all reduce SR versus C0 (0.9670 to 0.9099/0.9279/0.9414), while the best Calmar gain is only +0.0064 and correlations versus C0 are 0.9643 to 0.9899. Treating this as alpha discovery or promotion evidence is not defensible.

PIT claims rely on inheritance and assertion: 'already PIT-aligned' is not a current-WT Usable_Date proof, C13 Z_Score_Aligned output is not present, C15 load_month_factors() lineage is not present, and C4 fundamental lag is not re-audited.

Crowding, liquidity, cost, and turnover gates are not verifiable. The WT request contains weaker constraints than the base mandate (liquidity 50m vs 200m, weight_bounds [0,1] vs [0,0.20], max_names null/500 vs 20 hard), and no current holdings/weights schedule proves top-decile liquidity or annual turnover <600%.

Academic mechanism documentation is not schema-compliant: references are named but page-level citations are missing, mechanism text exceeds the <200자 requirement, and the STR_1715 single-sleeve success is imported into a diversified 4-sleeve baseline even though the package's own results show the transfer does not hold.

supporting_arguments: The source M4 schedule read by the script is monthly with no gaps and no future rows through 2026-03-01.
The implementation does apply a 1-month lag to beta_AR and M4 weights, supporting the narrow C9 overlay-lag claim.
The draft honestly reports that all three overlay specs reduce SR and that alpha-discovery orthogonality fails versus C0.
unresolved_disputes: Whether this WT is a discovery alpha package or only a documented negative overlay experiment; the current artifacts do not satisfy discovery package requirements.
Which stage artifact root is authoritative: requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260512_001 is missing, while stage_artifacts/WT_D20260512_001 contains only alpha_validation.json.
Whether lockbox reporting is compliant; the package uses a full window through 2026-05-01 but does not provide Pre-LB / Lockbox / Combined reporting.
Whether the missing full 5-spec Harvey test can be deferred; AX-002 implies final approval cannot rely on deferred Forge work.
Whether covariance PSD and condition number checks are in scope for this alpha draft; the requested covariance.parquet is absent.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that inherited PD30 score diagnostics plus portfolio-return overlay calculations are sufficient for this WT without emitting a fresh Date x Ticker x score alpha vector and current-WT PIT lineage.
rebuttal_required: Produce alpha_scores.parquet with Date x Ticker x score schema, >=60 monthly sig_dates, no future dates, and ticker-level universe/liquidity evidence.
Run full Harvey 5-spec testing and report CAPM, Carhart-3/4, FF5, and FF6 with Newey-West t-statistics and DSR using an explicit trial-count assumption.
Report ICIR, sub_stability, recent-3Y ICIR ratio, sector-neutral ICIR drop, monotonicity, and top-decile liquidity.
Provide WT-local weights.csv or explain why no optimizer schedule exists; reconcile hard constraints to max_names=20, weight_bounds=[0,0.20], liquidity >=2e8, and turnover <600%.
Add challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json with write_json to record_lineage ordering.
Separate Pre-LB, Lockbox, and Combined results before using post-2024 observations in any approval claim.
